resources.string: Only changes with a real technical effect. No placebo.
Prune does not kill processes, change CPU/GPU governors or touch thermal management. Those make phones less stable and often use more battery, not less.
Without Shizuku you can still export the change as an ADB script on the review screen.
Usage access is needed to know which apps you don\'t use.
Changing background access needs Shizuku or root. You can also set each app to \"Restricted\" in Settings → Apps → app → Battery.
No unused apps that still run in the background.
Android or the manufacturer exempt these themselves. They cannot be changed from here.
Notification permission exists from Android 13. Use Settings → Notifications on this version.
Usage access is needed to read app sizes.
Usage access is needed for screen time.
Battery estimates need Shizuku or root (they come from dumpsys batterystats).
Battery figures are Android\'s own estimate since the last full charge. They are approximate and not available on every firmware.
Runs the same job Android runs overnight. It can take 5–20 minutes and the phone may get warm. Best done while charging.
Off: only apps you installed and third-party preloads.
